## [Biosolids, sludge and food organics outside the cap]{.en}[配额外的生物固体、污泥与厨余]{.zh}

::: {.en}
**Table 4. Streams outside the cap**

::: tw
| Stream | Landfilled 2024–25 | Buyers | Incumbents | Timing | What CDEG sells |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Biosolids | 167,000 t | Melbourne Water; regional water corporations | TRILITY (Barwon dryer, 60,000 t/yr) \[60, 61\]; RMIT PYROCO pyrolysis \[62\] | Melbourne Water feasibility 2026–31; Barwon PPP ends about 2032 [to verify]{.verify} | Sludge drying and incineration O&M, technical services |
| Food organics | 437,000 t | Councils; organics processors (e.g. Repurpose It, 200,000 t/yr \[63\]) | 80 organics facilities and 8 digesters statewide \[29\] | FOGO for all households by 2030 \[34\] | Decontamination and digestion equipment, plus a pilot |
:::

*Sources: \[28, 29, 34, 60–63\]. Prices per tonne are not published, so these streams are sized in tonnes only.*

Neither stream needs a cap licence or equity. A pilot or service contract may still need the Melbourne entity, and therefore FIRB (2.3). The state names decontamination and pre-processing of contaminated FOGO as an investment gap \[29\], and its organics fund has backed eight projects \[64\].
:::

::: {.zh}
**表4：配额外的垃圾流**

::: tw
| 垃圾流 | 2024–25年填埋量 | 买方 | 现有参与者 | 时间 | 集团提供什么 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 生物固体 | 16.7万吨 | Melbourne Water；地区水务公司 | TRILITY（Barwon干化设施，6万吨/年）\[60, 61\]；RMIT PYROCO热解 \[62\] | Melbourne Water可行性研究2026–31年；Barwon PPP约2032年到期 [待核实]{.verify} | 污泥干化与焚烧运营、技术服务 |
| 厨余有机垃圾 | 43.7万吨 | 市政；有机物处理企业（如Repurpose It，20万吨/年 \[63\]） | 全州80家有机物处理设施、8座厌氧消化设施 \[29\] | 2030年前所有家庭实行FOGO \[34\] | 去杂质和厌氧消化设备，以及试点 |
:::

*来源：\[28, 29, 34, 60–63\]。每吨价格未公开，因此这两类垃圾流仅按吨数测算。*

这两类垃圾流都不需要配额许可或股权投资。但试点或服务合同仍可能需要设立墨尔本实体，因而需要FIRB批准（2.3）。州政府将受污染FOGO的去杂质和预处理列为投资缺口 \[29\]，其有机物基金已资助八个项目 \[64\]。
:::

## [How the money flows]{.en}[资金流向]{.zh}

::: {.en}
**Water corporations pay for biosolids treatment through long-term service contracts or public-private partnerships.**

-   Barwon Water's biosolids project is a Partnerships Victoria PPP \[60\]. TRILITY operates its thermal dryer, which takes 60,000 t/yr \[61\].
-   Melbourne Water tendered for a biosolids processing solution in March–June 2025 \[58\]. It is also studying a plant that burns residual waste and uses the waste heat to dry sludge, with private participation possible \[7\].
-   Biosolids burnt on their own need no cap licence \[36\], so the buyer is the water corporation, not a cap-licence holder.

::: {.placeholder}
- Diagram: who pays whom
:::
:::

::: {.zh}
**水务公司通过长期服务合同或公私合营（PPP）为生物固体处理付费。**

-   Barwon Water的生物固体项目是维州政府合作伙伴计划（Partnerships Victoria）下的PPP项目 \[60\]。TRILITY运营其热干化设施，处理能力6万吨/年 \[61\]。
-   Melbourne Water于2025年3–6月就生物固体处理方案进行招标 \[58\]。它还在研究一座焚烧剩余垃圾、利用余热干化污泥的电厂，并可能引入私营参与 \[7\]。
-   单独焚烧的生物固体不需要配额许可 \[36\]，因此买方是水务公司，而不是配额许可持有方。
